message.content: {"disposition":"adopt","rationale":"Concrete hypothesis: adding a positive holding_tip_speed_weight (0.0 -> 0.01) that penalizes squared world tip speed at/after the settling-window start will pull the sampled holding speed down from its failing band toward the settling limit. Relevance: the only grantable weight that directly prices settling-window tip speed is exactly zero (holding_tip_speed_weight F86 = 0.0), while the sampled holding speed fails badly (holding_window speed_m_s range [F20 = 0.6351726092425104, F27 = 1.5810152739742807] m/s, late_max_speed_m_s F6 = 1.5810152739742807 m/s) against speed_limit_m_s F62 = 0.02 m/s, and holding position also fails (late_max_error_m F10 = 0.05813810428573256 m vs position_limit_m F61 = 0.01 m). The term is scaled by 1/tip_speed_scale_m_s^2 (tip_speed_scale_m_s F73 = 0.02 -> 2500 per (m/s)^2), so 0.01 gives a normalized cost of only ~0.01 at the 0.02 m/s limit (so it does not fight already-slow motion) but ~10-62 at the observed 0.6-1.6 m/s - a decisively non-zero, feasible delta. This is a bounded, permitted single-candidate experiment; the absence of causal proof alone does not forbid it, and this selection is made independently of the diagnosis's defer recommendation. Possible adverse effects: the late speed penalty could trade away the currently marginal terminal reach (terminal_error_m F47 = 0.007642608585867386 m vs reach_tolerance_m F13 = 0.01 m) or worsen holding position, and could add solver cost given mean_update_s F44 = 17.26331904856488 s already far exceeds control_period_s F48 = 0.01 s. Observations that would weaken the hypothesis: holding speed stays in or worsens from the 0.6-1.6 m/s band, reach flips to false, holding position error grows, or solver stopping/status counts degrade - any of which would indicate the zero holding weight is not the operative lever at this single execution.","expected_measurable_effect":"Reach: reach_passed (F40 = true) should remain true with terminal_error_m (F47) still <= reach_tolerance_m (F13 = 0.01 m); a flip to false disfavors the hypothesis. Holding speed: holding_window speed_m_s [F20, F27] and late_max_speed_m_s (F6) should decrease materially from [0.6351726092425104, 1.5810152739742807] m/s toward speed_limit_m_s (F62 = 0.02 m/s). Holding position: with holding_position_passed F62 = false and late_max_error_m F10 = 0.05813810428573256 m, error should improve or at least not worsen relative to position_limit_m F61 = 0.01 m. Computation: track mean_update_s (F44), stopping_counts Solve_Succeeded F18 = 1 / User_Requested_Stop F68 = 34, and deadline_misses F16 = 35 with no claim of solver improvement. A paired local comparison at saved update 34 (effective plan horizon 0.01 s) gives a baseline-versus-0.01 screening for this single changed positive weight before/with the complete run.","changes":{"control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight":0.01},"local_comparison":{"update_id":34,"parameter":"holding_tip_speed_weight"}}
